reading.rtitle: Italy and Brazil -- Two Countries, One Heart
paras: Brazil is much bigger than Italy. You can put Italy inside Brazil more than twenty times! But Italy is older, and in every small village there is a church or a square with hundreds of years of history.

São Paulo is a huge city with more than eleven million people. Next to it, Florence is tiny: about three hundred and sixty thousand people live there. The streets in Florence are narrower and quieter, and you can walk almost everywhere.

In January it is summer in Brazil and winter in Italy, so Brazil is much warmer. In Tuscany the villages on the hills are more peaceful than the big cities, and the coast is beautiful in July. Italian pizza is famous, but many visitors say that Brazilian coffee is stronger.

listenings.text: Good morning, everybody, and welcome to our Tuscany tour. Today we visit two places, Siena and a small village called Monteriggioni. Siena is bigger and busier, with many shops, museums and restaurants. Monteriggioni is tiny. Only about forty people live inside the old walls, so it is much quieter and more peaceful. The road to the village is narrow, and our bus is huge, so please be patient. From the hill you can see green fields everywhere. Lunch today is in Siena. The restaurant is more expensive than the cafe in the village, but the pasta is better. We are back in Florence at six o'clock. Enjoy the day.

Hi Marlene, it is Giulia from the hotel. You asked me about a weekend by the sea. I have two ideas for you. The first is Viareggio. It is closer to Florence, only one hour by train, and the beach is wide and long. But on Saturday it is very crowded. The second is a small village on the coast called Porto Ercole. It is farther, about three hours by car, but it is smaller, quieter and more beautiful. The hotels there are more expensive, so the trip is not cheaper. For a peaceful weekend, I think Porto Ercole is better. Call me if you want the address. Bye.

extra_audio.text: First, you leave the huge city of São Paulo and you fly to Italy. Then you arrive in Florence, and the narrow streets are quieter than at home. Next, you take a bus up the hill to a tiny village. After that, you have lunch in the village, and it is more peaceful than the city. Finally, you spend a weekend on the coast and you swim in the sea.
